newsitem.title: HONG KONG: British general says PLA has good sense of humour.
newsitem.headline: British general says PLA has good sense of humour.

text.p: Britain's garrison chief in Hong Kong, Major General Bryan Dutton, said on Thursday he was delighted to find that his Chinese counterparts in the People's Liberation Army (PLA) have a good sense of humour.
Dutton recently suggested to the PLA that they might be making a mistake in sending five Chinese generals to replace him when Hong Kong reverts to Chinese rule at midnight on June 30.
"I said I wasn't quite sure this was a good message since it implied that it took five Chinese generals to do what it took one British General to do," Dutton told the Foreign Correspondents' Club.
"They looked at me very quizzically and then they said 'Yes General, but five Chinese Generals come much cheaper than one British General."

Dutton declined to compare his salary to that of an equivalent PLA officer. But he did say the lowest paid British soldier in Hong Kong makes about HK$12,000 (US$1,550) per month compared to a base salary of HK$40 (US$ 5.17) for a soldier in the PLA garrison.
